plugin.name: entry-cursor
plugin._long: Hides the pointer at compositor start until the shell's entry curtain lifts, with a failsafe timeout so the pointer cannot stay hidden.

option.name: hide_at_start
option._long: Hides the pointer as soon as the compositor initializes.

option.name: timeout_ms
option._long: Restores the pointer automatically if the shell does not reveal it within this many milliseconds.
